title: Nvidia was founded at a Denny's booth
summary: Nvidia's three co-founders decided to start the company at a Denny's in San Jose in 1993. Its NV1 chip failed in 1995 and nearly bankrupted it; the RIVA 128 in 1997 was a commercial success.

beats.say: Three engineers started Nvidia at a Denny's booth.
In nineteen ninety three, they decided to build a company around three D graphics.
One founder had worked at that same Denny's as a busboy.
By nineteen ninety five, the company had developed a chip called the N V one.
It failed technically and nearly pushed the company into bankruptcy.
A contract buyout with Sega brought financial relief and resources.
The next chip, R I V A one twenty eight, came out in nineteen ninety seven.
One chip nearly ended the company. The next was a hit.
The company began with a conversation in a diner booth.
